chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: The Reno Club broadcasts and the name 'Count'
summary: Basie declines to tell how he got the name Count, saying she can get it from another book.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I haven't the vaguest notion. "Under Basie's leadership, the band broadcast over station -- W9XBY MR. BASIE: WXBY or WHB? MS. : It says W9XBY -- "from their residence at the Reno Club, Kansas City. From that time, Bill Basie was dubbed 'Count.'"
Carry on. Okay. Could you tell me how you got the name Count Basie, 'Count'?
Does it tell you in there?
Not in here. This is just a -- kind of an encyclopedia thing, entry.
Well, if you haven't got that, I ain't going to give it to you.
Okay, I got it in another book, so we can check that out.
